investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Velwell Learning (online learning); Platform: AWS ap-south-1 (zones ap-south-1a/ap-south-1b/ap-south-1c); network range 10.188.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster velwel-prod-apsout (EKS); video-api pods run with 8 GiB memory limits; deployments are canary releases with automated analysis; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
